title: Builder’s Tea: Strong, Milky British Tea
description: Builder’s tea is strong, milky British tea brewed for 3–4 minutes with 1 tea bag, 300 ml water and 50 ml whole milk.
introduction: Builder’s tea is strong, milky British tea brewed with 1 tea bag and 300 ml freshly boiled water for 3–4 minutes, then finished with 50 ml whole milk. Learn the authentic method with metric quantities and step-by-step guidance.
